notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.5
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that could trigger a persistent softlock on the final boss. If your save file was previously affected by this issue, then this update will automatically repair it.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.3
notes.content:
- A bug causing the powered up psybomb to detonate early in some situations has been resolved
- Physics bugs with the pushable crates fixed
- Labels on the overworld and navmaps fixed
- Enabled setting of --fullscreen launch parameter from Steam
